CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_factory_owner.c395_binding_insert_assert_v1(p_session uuid, p_definition uuid, p_snapshot jsonb, p_sha text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE q mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources;m public.master_v2_sessions;p mission_factory_owner.c395_prepared_sources;r mission_factory_owner.c395_quest_revisions;
BEGIN
SELECT * INTO STRICT q FROM mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources WHERE session_id=p_session FOR SHARE;
SELECT * INTO STRICT m FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=p_session FOR SHARE;
SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM mission_factory_owner.c395_prepared_sources WHERE session_id=p_session FOR SHARE;
SELECT * INTO STRICT r FROM mission_factory_owner.c395_quest_revisions WHERE id=p.revision_id FOR SHARE;
IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR m.master_user IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()
OR m.owner_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'human' OR m.mission_id IS NOT NULL OR m.tipo IS DISTINCT FROM 'quest'
OR p.assigned_master IS DISTINCT FROM m.master_user OR r.assigned_master IS DISTINCT FROM m.master_user
OR q.episode_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.episode_id OR q.arc_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.arc_id OR q.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM r.source_sha256
OR p_definition IS DISTINCT FROM q.definition_id OR p_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM mission_factory_owner.c395_binding_projection_v1(q)
OR p_sha IS DISTINCT FROM mission_internal.fingerprint(p_snapshot)
OR ((q.availability_scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff' OR q.execution_context IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_simulation') AND NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_factory_owner.quest_arcs gx_a
JOIN mission_factory_owner.quest_episodes gx_e ON gx_e.arc_id=gx_a.id AND gx_e.id=q.episode_id
JOIN public.locations gx_l ON gx_l.id=q.location_id
WHERE gx_a.id=q.arc_id AND q.availability_scope='public' AND gx_a.availability_scope='public'
AND gx_a.source_document->>'content_kind'='quest_human'
AND q.execution_context=gx_a.execution_context AND q.execution_context IN('staff_simulation','public_real')
AND q.public_release_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gx_a.public_release_sha256
AND q.execution_qualification_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gx_a.execution_qualification_sha256
AND q.source_sha256=gx_e.source_sha256 AND gx_e.source_sha256=mission_factory_owner.sha(gx_e.source_document)
AND q.roster_character_ids IS NOT DISTINCT FROM gx_e.member_character_ids
AND gx_l.is_active AND gx_l.is_test=(q.execution_context='staff_simulation')
AND ((q.execution_context='staff_simulation' AND gx_l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
AND combat_consumer_private.staff_test_allowed(gx_l.id,array_append(ARRAY(SELECT gx_c.user_id FROM unnest(q.roster_character_ids)WITH ORDINALITY gx_ids(id,ord) JOIN public.characters gx_c ON gx_c.id=gx_ids.id ORDER BY gx_ids.ord),auth.uid()),false) IS TRUE)
OR(q.execution_context='public_real' AND NOT coalesce(gx_l.is_exam_room,false)))
AND mission_factory_owner.human_ordinary_arc_scope_v1(gx_a.id,true) IS TRUE)))
OR q.location_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.location_id
THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C395_HUMAN_BINDING_SOURCE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
END $function$

BEGIN
IF u IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR p_session IS NULL
THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C384_NORMAL_AUTH_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;

SELECT * INTO STRICT v FROM mission_factory_owner.c384_authoring_versions WHERE lineage_id=b.lineage_id AND version=b.authoring_version;
SELECT * INTO STRICT m FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=b.session_id;
SELECT * INTO STRICT e FROM mission_factory_owner.quest_episodes WHERE id=b.episode_id;
SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM mission_generic_owner.definitions WHERE id=b.definition_id;
IF m.master_user IS DISTINCT FROM b.assigned_master OR m.owner_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'human'
OR m.tipo IS DISTINCT FROM 'quest' OR m.mission_id IS NOT NULL OR public.master_v2_is_master(b.assigned_master) IS DISTINCT FROM true
OR b.binding_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM mission_factory_owner.sha(b.binding_snapshot)
OR v.document_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM mission_factory_owner.sha(v.document)
OR v.document#>>'{variants,human,state}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'complete'
OR v.document#>>'{variants,human,mode}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'human'
OR e.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_sha256 OR e.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM mission_factory_owner.sha(e.source_document)
OR d.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM b.definition_sha256 OR d.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM mission_internal.fingerprint(d.definition)
OR d.definition->>'quest_episode_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e.id::text OR d.definition->>'source_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM e.source_sha256
OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(b.binding_snapshot,ARRAY['schema_version','direction_mode','session_id','assigned_master','lineage_id','authoring_version','authoring_sha256','episode_id','source_sha256','definition_sha256','human_variant_sha256','mechanical_sha256'])
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'lineage_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.lineage_id::text
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'authoring_version' IS DISTINCT FROM b.authoring_version::text
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'authoring_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM v.document_sha256
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'human_variant_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM v.human_variant_sha256
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'mechanical_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM v.mechanical_sha256
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'quest-human-binding/3'
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'direction_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'human'
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'assigned_master' IS DISTINCT FROM b.assigned_master::text
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.session_id::text
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'episode_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.episode_id::text
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'definition_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.definition_sha256
OR b.binding_snapshot->>'source_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.source_sha256
THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C384_IMMUTABLE_HUMAN_IDENTITY_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
IF u IS DISTINCT FROM b.assigned_master AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_participants p JOIN public.characters c ON c.id=p.character_id AND c.user_id=p.user_id_snapshot JOIN mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q ON q.session_id=p.session_id WHERE p.session_id=p_session AND p.user_id_snapshot=u AND c.user_id=u AND p.character_id=ANY(q.roster_character_ids) AND p.left_at IS NULL AND p.engagement_state='attivo' AND ((q.availability_scope='staff' AND q.execution_context='staff_simulation' AND q.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid) OR mission_factory_owner.human_ordinary_arc_scope_v1(q.arc_id,q.state NOT IN('terminal','cancelled'))))
THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C412_MASTER_OR_NATIVE_ROSTER_READ_REQUIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
-- Deliberatamente nessun active/closed assert qui: anche una replay conclusa autentica prima.
RETURN b.binding_snapshot;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_factory_owner.human_existing_legacy_media_pair_v1(p_template uuid, p_narrative_version uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  t public.nb_templates%rowtype;
  v public.nb_template_versions%rowtype;
  h png_builder_internal.npc_combat_draft_heads%rowtype;
  pair png_builder_internal.npc_media_pairs%rowtype;
  pt png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets%rowtype;
  mt png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets%rowtype;
  portrait public.nb_template_media_versions%rowtype;
  marker png_builder_internal.npc_marker_versions%rowtype;
begin
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nb_mechanical_bindings cb JOIN public.nb_mechanical_versions cv ON cv.id=cb.mechanical_version_id AND cv.template_id=cb.mechanical_template_id WHERE cb.narrative_template_id=p_template AND cb.narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version AND cb.active AND cb.lifecycle_state='approved' AND cv.profile_kind='npc_custom' AND cv.review_state='approved' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nb_mechanical_templates ct JOIN png_builder_internal.npc_combat_draft_heads ch ON ch.mechanical_template_id=ct.id AND ch.mechanical_version_id=cv.id AND ch.narrative_template_id=p_template AND ch.narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version AND ch.combat AND ch.review_state='approved' WHERE ct.id=cb.mechanical_template_id AND ct.active AND ct.lifecycle_state='approved' AND ct.current_version_id=cv.id)) THEN
   RETURN png_builder_internal.npc_media_pair_resolve_v1(p_template,p_narrative_version);
  END IF;
  if p_template is null or p_narrative_version is null then
    raise exception 'NPC_BUILDER_MEDIA_INPUT' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  select * into t from public.nb_templates where id=p_template;
  select * into v from public.nb_template_versions
    where id=p_narrative_version and template_id=p_template;
  select * into h from png_builder_internal.npc_combat_draft_heads
    where narrative_template_id=p_template and narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version;
  select * into pair from png_builder_internal.npc_media_pairs
    where template_id=p_template and narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version
      and state='approved';
  if t.id is null or t.deactivated_at is not null or
     t.lifecycle_state<>'approved' or
     t.current_version_id is distinct from p_narrative_version or
     v.id is null or v.review_state<>'approved' or
     (v.mechanical_template_id is null and h.narrative_template_id is not null and
       (h.combat is distinct from false or h.mechanical_template_id is not null or
        h.review_state<>'approved')) or
     (v.mechanical_template_id is not null and
       NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nb_mechanical_bindings lb JOIN public.nb_mechanical_templates lt ON lt.id=lb.mechanical_template_id JOIN public.nb_mechanical_versions lv ON lv.id=lb.mechanical_version_id AND lv.template_id=lt.id WHERE lb.narrative_template_id=t.id AND lb.narrative_version_id=v.id AND lb.active AND lb.lifecycle_state='approved' AND lt.id=v.mechanical_template_id AND lt.active AND lt.lifecycle_state='approved' AND lt.current_version_id=lv.id AND lv.review_state='approved' AND lv.profile_kind='legacy')) or
     pair.request_key is null or
     pair.narrative_content_sha256 is distinct from v.content_sha256 or
     pair.mechanical_template_id is distinct from v.mechanical_template_id then
    raise exception 'NPC_BUILDER_MEDIA_STALE' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  select * into pt from png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets
    where request_key=pair.portrait_request;
  select * into mt from png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets
    where request_key=pair.marker_request;
  select * into portrait from public.nb_template_media_versions
    where id=pt.media_id and template_id=p_template and
      template_version_id=p_narrative_version;
  select * into marker from png_builder_internal.npc_marker_versions
    where id=mt.media_id and template_id=p_template and
      narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version;
  if pt.request_key is null or mt.request_key is null or

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION png_builder_internal.npc_custom_combat_source_v1(p_template uuid, p_narrative_version uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare t public.nb_templates%rowtype; nv public.nb_template_versions%rowtype;
  h png_builder_internal.npc_combat_draft_heads%rowtype;
  mt public.nb_mechanical_templates%rowtype; mv public.nb_mechanical_versions%rowtype;
  mb public.nb_mechanical_bindings%rowtype; pair jsonb; snap jsonb;
  media uuid[]; portrait uuid; doc jsonb; dep text; mechanical_body jsonb;
begin
  select * into t from public.nb_templates where id=p_template for share;
  select * into nv from public.nb_template_versions
    where id=p_narrative_version and template_id=p_template for share;
  select * into h from png_builder_internal.npc_combat_draft_heads
    where narrative_template_id=p_template and narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version for share;
  if t.id is null or nv.id is null or h.narrative_template_id is null
     or t.current_version_id is distinct from nv.id or t.lifecycle_state<>'approved'
     or t.deactivated_at is not null or nv.review_state<>'approved'
     or h.review_state<>'approved' or h.combat is distinct from true
     or h.mechanical_template_id is null or h.mechanical_version_id is null
     or nv.mechanical_template_id is distinct from h.mechanical_template_id
  then raise exception 'MF_NPC_CUSTOM_SOURCE_STALE' using errcode='55000';end if;
  select * into mt from public.nb_mechanical_templates
    where id=h.mechanical_template_id for share;
  select * into mv from public.nb_mechanical_versions
    where id=h.mechanical_version_id and template_id=h.mechanical_template_id for share;
  select * into mb from public.nb_mechanical_bindings
    where narrative_template_id=p_template and narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version
      and mechanical_template_id=h.mechanical_template_id
      and mechanical_version_id=h.mechanical_version_id for share;
  mechanical_body:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
      'schema_version',mv.schema_version,'rank',mv.rank,'archetype',mv.archetype,
      'base_per_stat',mv.base_per_stat,'allocated_points',mv.allocated_points,
      'innata',mv.innata,'stats',mv.stats,'vita_max',mv.vita_max,
      'chakra_max',mv.chakra_max,'abilities',mv.abilities,'generation',mv.generation);
  if mt.id is null or mt.archetype<>'npc_custom' or mt.lifecycle_state<>'approved'
     or not mt.active or mt.current_version_id is distinct from mv.id
     or mv.id is null or mv.profile_kind<>'npc_custom'
     or mv.archetype<>'npc_custom' or mv.rank<>'NPC'
     or mv.review_state<>'approved' or mv.abilities<>'[]'::jsonb
     or mv.stats is distinct from h.payload->'stats'
     or mv.vita_max is distinct from (h.payload->>'vita_max')::integer
     or mv.chakra_max is distinct from (h.payload->>'chakra_max')::integer
     or mv.generation->'clan_ref' is distinct from h.payload->'clan_ref'
     or mv.generation->'chakra_element_ref' is distinct from h.payload->'chakra_element_ref'
     or mv.content_sha256 is distinct from pg_catalog.encode(extensions.digest(
          pg_catalog.convert_to(mechanical_body::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
     or not png_builder_internal.npc_combat_stats_safe(mv.stats)
     or mv.vita_max<=0 or mv.chakra_max<0
     or mb.id is null or mb.lifecycle_state<>'approved' or not mb.active
     or (select count(*) from public.nb_mechanical_bindings x
         where x.narrative_template_id=p_template
           and x.narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version
           and x.lifecycle_state='approved' and x.active)<>1
     or exists(select 1 from public.nb_mechanical_ability_profile_refs_v1 ar
        where ar.mechanical_template_id=mt.id and ar.lifecycle_state='approved' and ar.active)
  then raise exception 'MF_NPC_CUSTOM_MECHANICS_STALE' using errcode='55000';end if;
  snap:=public.nb_mechanical_resolve(p_narrative_version);
  if snap->>'mechanical_template_ref' is distinct from mt.id::text
     or snap->>'mechanical_version_ref' is distinct from mv.id::text
     or snap->>'source_sha256' is distinct from mv.content_sha256
     or snap#>'{snapshot,stats}' is distinct from mv.stats
     or snap#>'{snapshot,abilities}' is distinct from '[]'::jsonb
     or (snap#>>'{snapshot,vita_max}')::integer is distinct from mv.vita_max
     or (snap#>>'{snapshot,chakra_max}')::integer is distinct from mv.chakra_max
  then raise exception 'MF_NPC_CUSTOM_SNAPSHOT_STALE' using errcode='55000';end if;
  pair:=png_builder_internal.npc_media_pair_resolve_v1(p_template,p_narrative_version);
  if pair->>'mechanical_template_id' is distinct from mt.id::text
     or pair->>'narrative_content_sha256' is distinct from nv.content_sha256
  then raise exception 'MF_NPC_CUSTOM_MEDIA_STALE' using errcode='55000';end if;
  portrait:=(pair->>'portrait_media_id')::uuid;
  select coalesce(array_agg(m.id order by m.media_version_no,m.id),array[]::uuid[])
    into media from public.nb_template_media_versions m
    where m.template_id=p_template and m.template_version_id=p_narrative_version
      and m.lifecycle_state='approved' and m.active
      and m.sha256=m.verified_sha256;
  if cardinality(media)=0 or portrait<>all(media)
     or cardinality(media)<>(select count(*)::integer from public.nb_template_media_versions m
       where m.template_id=p_template and m.template_version_id=p_narrative_version
         and m.lifecycle_state='approved' and m.active)
  then raise exception 'MF_NPC_CUSTOM_MEDIA_STALE' using errcode='55000';end if;
  doc:=pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'schema_version','png-builder-sheet/1.0',
    'template_key',t.template_key,'display_name',t.display_name,
    'village_scope',t.village_scope,'source_template_id',t.id,
    'source_template_version_id',nv.id,
    'source_mechanical_template_id',mt.id,'source_mechanical_version_id',mv.id,
    'skeleton',nv.skeleton,'knowledge_boundary',nv.knowledge_boundary,
    'fallback_profile',nv.fallback_profile,
    'media_ids',to_jsonb(media),'ability_refs','[]'::jsonb,
    'consumer_scopes',pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(
      'surface','narrator_adapter','master_v2','combat_v2'));
  dep:=png_builder_internal.sha(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'schema_version','npc-custom-combat-dependency/1',
    'narrative_sha256',nv.content_sha256,'mechanical_sha256',mv.content_sha256,
    'mechanical_binding_id',mb.id,'media_pair',pair,
    'builder_document_sha256',png_builder_internal.sha(doc),
    'snapshot',snap));
  return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('document',doc,'dependency_sha256',dep,
    'pair_request_key',pair->>'pair_request_key',
    'mechanical_version_id',mv.id,'mechanical_binding_id',mb.id);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION png_builder_internal.npc_media_pair_resolve_v1(p_template uuid, p_narrative_version uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  t public.nb_templates%rowtype;
  v public.nb_template_versions%rowtype;
  h png_builder_internal.npc_combat_draft_heads%rowtype;
  pair png_builder_internal.npc_media_pairs%rowtype;
  pt png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets%rowtype;
  mt png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets%rowtype;
  portrait public.nb_template_media_versions%rowtype;
  marker png_builder_internal.npc_marker_versions%rowtype;
begin
  if p_template is null or p_narrative_version is null then
    raise exception 'NPC_BUILDER_MEDIA_INPUT' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  select * into t from public.nb_templates where id=p_template;
  select * into v from public.nb_template_versions
    where id=p_narrative_version and template_id=p_template;
  select * into h from png_builder_internal.npc_combat_draft_heads
    where narrative_template_id=p_template and narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version;
  select * into pair from png_builder_internal.npc_media_pairs
    where template_id=p_template and narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version
      and state='approved';
  if t.id is null or t.deactivated_at is not null or
     t.lifecycle_state<>'approved' or
     t.current_version_id is distinct from p_narrative_version or
     v.id is null or v.review_state<>'approved' or
     (v.mechanical_template_id is null and h.narrative_template_id is not null and
       (h.combat is distinct from false or h.mechanical_template_id is not null or
        h.review_state<>'approved')) or
     (v.mechanical_template_id is not null and
       (h.narrative_template_id is null or h.combat is distinct from true or
        h.review_state<>'approved' or
        v.mechanical_template_id is distinct from h.mechanical_template_id)) or
     pair.request_key is null or
     pair.narrative_content_sha256 is distinct from v.content_sha256 or
     pair.mechanical_template_id is distinct from v.mechanical_template_id then
    raise exception 'NPC_BUILDER_MEDIA_STALE' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  select * into pt from png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets
    where request_key=pair.portrait_request;
  select * into mt from png_builder_internal.npc_media_tickets
    where request_key=pair.marker_request;
  select * into portrait from public.nb_template_media_versions
    where id=pt.media_id and template_id=p_template and
      template_version_id=p_narrative_version;
  select * into marker from png_builder_internal.npc_marker_versions
    where id=mt.media_id and template_id=p_template and
      narrative_version_id=p_narrative_version;
  if pt.request_key is null or mt.request_key is null or
     pt.kind<>'portrait' or mt.kind<>'marker' or
     pt.template_id is distinct from p_template or
     mt.template_id is distinct from p_template or
     pt.state<>'approved' or mt.state<>'approved' or
     pt.narrative_version_id is distinct from p_narrative_version or
     mt.narrative_version_id is distinct from p_narrative_version or
     pt.narrative_content_sha256 is distinct from v.content_sha256 or
     mt.narrative_content_sha256 is distinct from v.content_sha256 or
     pt.mechanical_template_id is distinct from v.mechanical_template_id or
     mt.mechanical_template_id is distinct from v.mechanical_template_id or
     portrait.id is null or portrait.lifecycle_state<>'approved' or not portrait.active or
     portrait.kind<>'canonical_full_body' or
     portrait.sha256 is distinct from pt.sha256 or
     portrait.verified_sha256 is distinct from pt.sha256 or
     portrait.asset_id is distinct from pt.asset_id or
     portrait.bucket is distinct from pt.bucket or
     portrait.object_path is distinct from pt.object_path or
     portrait.mime_type is distinct from pt.mime_type or
     portrait.bytes is distinct from pt.bytes or
     marker.id is null or marker.state<>'approved' or not marker.active or
     marker.sha256 is distinct from mt.sha256 or
     marker.asset_id is distinct from mt.asset_id or
     marker.bucket is distinct from mt.bucket or
     marker.object_path is distinct from mt.object_path or
     marker.mime_type is distinct from mt.mime_type or
     marker.bytes is distinct from mt.bytes then
    raise exception 'NPC_BUILDER_MEDIA_STALE' using errcode='55000';
  end if;
  return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'schema_version','npc-builder-media-pair/1',
    'template_id',p_template,'narrative_version_id',p_narrative_version,
    'narrative_content_sha256',v.content_sha256,
    'mechanical_template_id',v.mechanical_template_id,
    'pair_request_key',pair.request_key,
    'portrait_media_id',portrait.id,'portrait_sha256',portrait.sha256,
    'portrait_asset_id',portrait.asset_id,
    'marker_media_id',marker.id,'marker_sha256',marker.sha256,
    'marker_asset_id',marker.asset_id);
end $function$
